name: neatlogs
purpose: The neatlogs TypeScript SDK (1.1.26) wraps every queue item, recon step, probe and model call in a span via withSpan; probe spans carry the prediction committed before the call, and Bedrock calls are captured with the SDK's wrapBedrock. Every span is also written to runs/<runId>/spans.jsonl, which the evidence checks read.
notes: Status "live" covers SDK export only: on Oct 12, with NEATLOGS_API_KEY set, `pnpm notary doctor` flushed one real span and the SDK reported the flush as successful (trace c4cc92921c1c495ebf24b8cf6fc0b599, span fa01f88a77c2c721). Beyond that smoke span, 2 notarize/run trace(s) are marked exported in local spans.jsonl files. The trace has not been read back, since neatlogs-cli is not installed and the neatlogs trace URL format is unknown, so there is no trace link. Bundle traceLinks point to local spans.jsonl receipts.

name: Entire
purpose: Entire checkpoints the AI agent sessions that write this repo: with `entire enable --agent claude-code`, every commit made during a Claude Code session carries an Entire-Checkpoint trailer linking it to that session's transcript, prompts and files touched. The adversary's session backend is a headless Claude Code review whose verdict is committed, so each review is checkpointed next to its belief. `notary guards coverage --backend entire` runs one `entire graph edges` pass and fails on any caller of a money-moving tool method outside the guard wrapper. packages/web/public/evidence/entire.json (`notary export --entire`) lists the checkpoints and the coverage result.

links.label: Entire docs: entire graph command reference (DECISIONS #61)

notes: The Entire CLI is on PATH and checkpoints exist (refs/entire/checkpoints); `notary export --entire` lists them in packages/web/public/evidence/entire.json with their sessions, commits and files touched. The project repo (github.com/parthchilwerwar/notary) is private, so the checkpoint history is not public.
